displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that libertarian freedom is a graded capacity for reasons-responsive self-direction when multiple actions remain causally possible and the agent's integrated evaluative activity nonredundantly helps settle which action occurs.

novelty.explanation: This formulation repairs the missing authorship relation and limits the claim to graded, reasons-responsive self-direction.

premises.text: Some deliberative episodes contain multiple action pathways that remain physically admissible until evaluation is completed, rather than one pathway already being causally sufficient.

novelty.explanation: This develops the proposed interaction between lower-level indeterminacy and system-level constraint.

premises.text: An outcome is attributable to an agent when the agent's integrated reasons, attention, inhibition, and endorsement alter the comparative disposition toward that outcome in a difference-making way.

novelty.explanation: This supplies a positive, nonabsolute criterion for authorship that answers the residual-selection objection.

premises.text: Authorship need not mean creating one's initial character; it can consist in recursively modifying inherited dispositions through earlier episodes meeting the same difference-making standard.

novelty.explanation: This narrows sourcehood to recursive partial authorship rather than impossible total self-creation.

premises.text: Responsibility should increase with the quality of accessible alternatives, evaluative understanding, self-regulatory capacity, and the agent's historical contribution to the dispositions expressed.

novelty.explanation: This operationalizes the degree account by naming several independently assessable dimensions.

premises.text: Deterministic counterfactual modeling can explain option representation, but it does not by itself explain why deliberative evaluation is a difference-maker among causally possible outcomes.

novelty.explanation: This directly compares the libertarian explanation with the strongest deterministic representation alternative.

conclusion.text: Therefore, if deliberative integration sometimes makes a difference among causally possible actions, agents can possess limited libertarian freedom and responsibility without being wholly self-created or exempt from formative constraints.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately combines causal openness, partial authorship, and graded responsibility.

newArguments.title: Intervention-sensitive authorship
newArguments.text: Authorship can be tested counterfactually at the level of the integrated agent without requiring deterministic sufficiency. If a controlled change in attended reasons, reflective endorsement, or inhibition would systematically change the distribution of possible actions, those processes are causally difference-making. The eventual action is then neither detached chance nor the inevitable output of antecedent conditions: it is an outcome whose probability and admissibility were shaped by the agent's evaluative organization. This does not prove that human brains instantiate the model, but it clarifies what empirical evidence would support the libertarian claim.

novelty.explanation: This introduces an intervention-based empirical criterion not stated in the participant's argument.

newArguments.title: Opportunity-profile responsibility
newArguments.text: A live option should be modeled as a profile rather than a binary status. Relevant dimensions include physical availability, cognitive representation, normative comprehension, emotional tolerability, practical feasibility, and access to reasons supporting the option. Responsibility can track the weakest and strongest dimensions together, explaining why coercion, deprivation, manipulation, and entrenched upbringing reduce agency differently. Libertarian openness contributes only where more than one sufficiently developed profile remains causally possible. This framework answers the threshold challenge by making judgments contestable through evidence about capacities and circumstances rather than unsupported intuition.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the underspecified live-option criterion with a multidimensional, evidence-sensitive framework.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that freedom sufficient for practical agency and graded responsibility consists in conduct issuing from the person's reasons-responsive capacities without coercive bypass, even if the complete causal history is deterministic.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the surviving-freedom standard with embodied causation and willing conduct.

premises.text: Determinism does not erase causal organization: deliberation, inhibition, planning, character, and neural processing can remain genuine components of the person's action-producing mechanism.

novelty.explanation: This develops embodied proximal causation into a structured mechanism of practical agency.

premises.text: A choice differs from a nonchoice when it proceeds through capacities that register reasons and can vary conduct across relevant counterfactual circumstances, even if the actual history is determined.

novelty.explanation: This supplies the normative and counterfactual bridge missing from mere classificatory survival.

premises.text: Random resolution among options cannot add the control missing from an agent's evaluative mechanism, because unexplained variation does not strengthen ownership, comprehension, or reasons-responsiveness.

novelty.explanation: This clarifies the authorship-relevant objection to stochastic resolution without equating all probability with chaos.

premises.text: Because criteria and opportunities are unequally formed, responsibility should vary with competence, informational access, coercion, manipulation, and the mechanism's capacity to respond to reasons.

novelty.explanation: This converts formative constraints into explicit dimensions for graded compatibilist responsibility.

premises.text: Responsibility practices require independent normative evaluation according to protection, recognition, answerability, repair, and fair opportunity, rather than validation merely because communities already employ them.

novelty.explanation: This supplies standards for criticizing and revising inherited reactive attitudes and practices.

conclusion.text: Therefore, determinism can preserve meaningful choice and proportionate responsibility when conduct expresses an embodied, reasons-responsive mechanism under fair evaluative conditions, without requiring categorical alternatives or ultimate self-origination.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion connects practical survival to explicit causal and normative conditions.

newArguments.title: Mechanism ownership without ultimacy
newArguments.text: Ownership can be analyzed through integration rather than ultimate origination. A mechanism belongs to the person when its perceptions, memories, values, planning, inhibition, and learning interact coherently over time; when it is not bypassed by compulsion or manipulation; and when criticism can update later conduct. Deterministic formation does not eliminate these relations, just as causal formation does not eliminate ownership of knowledge or skills. This model explains why brain causation can be personal causation while still distinguishing ordinary agency from seizure, coercion, addiction, and externally implanted motivation.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a structured integration-and-bypass account of personal ownership.

newArguments.title: Normative audit of responsibility practices
newArguments.text: A plural practice-based theory can avoid conservatism by requiring every responsibility practice to pass a public normative audit. Praise, blame, sanction, forgiveness, and demands for explanation should be evaluated for accuracy, proportionality, fair opportunity, harm reduction, recognition, and capacity to improve future agency. Practices failing these conditions should be revised even when socially entrenched. This framework preserves Folley's pragmatic plurality while answering the objection that existing reactive attitudes may encode prejudice or unsupported metaphysics. It also permits different practices to serve different legitimate purposes without pretending they express one essence.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the normative gap by providing public standards for retaining or revising practices.
